v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: The Lord hath reigned * let the earth rejoice. ‡

text.la: Te decet hymnus, * Deus, in Sion. ‡
text.en: A hymn, O God, * becometh thee in Sion. ‡

text.la: Tibi, Dómine, psallam, * et intéllegam in via immaculáta.
text.en: I shall sing to thee, O Lord * and I shall understand with a perfect heart.

text.la: Dómine, magnus es tu, * et præclárus in virtúte tua.
text.en: O Lord, great art thou * and glorious in thy power.

text.la: Laudábo Deum meum * in vita mea.
text.en: I shall praise the Lord * in my life.

text.la: Fratres: Qui gloriátur, in Dómino gloriétur. Non enim qui seípsum comméndat, ille probátus est; sed quem Deus comméndat.
text.en: Brothers: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord. For not he who commendeth himself, is approved, but he, whom God commendeth.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Símile est regnum cælórum * hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam.
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman * seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

text.la: Bonórum ómnium largítor, omnípotens Deus, qui beátam Rosam, cæléstis grátiæ rore prævéntam, virginitátis et patiéntiæ decóre Indis floréscere voluísti: da nobis fámulis tuis; ut, in odórem suavitátis eius curréntes, Christi bonus odor éffici mereámur:
text.en: Almighty God, from Whom cometh down every good and perfect gift, and Who didst cause the dew of thy grace to fall early from heaven upon this blessed Rose, making the same to blossom in the Indies, as a flower whose loveliness was virginity and long-suffering, grant unto thy servants, who do run after the smell of her perfumes, worthily themselves to become a sweet savour unto Christ. Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

text.la: Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
text.en: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Maiestátem tuam, Dómine, súpplices exorámus: ut, sicut nos iúgiter Sanctórum tuórum commemoratióne lætíficas; ita semper supplicatióne deféndas.
text.en: We humbly beseech thy Majesty, O Lord, that as Thou dost make us exceeding glad at the remembrance of thine holy servants, so Thou wouldest ever shelter us under their prayers.

office.title: S. Rosæ a Sancta Maria Limanæ Virginis
